name: Protein-ligand structure and conformation benchmark
description: A benchmark for jointly evaluating methods that predict protein structures and ligand conformations (protein–ligand complex modeling).
evaluation_method: Ligand pose RMSD (root-mean-square deviation) to native structure and pose success rate (fraction of predictions within a threshold, e.g., ≤2.0 Å)
general_score_metric: Median ligand RMSD and success rate within 2 Å
typical_sota_score: median RMSD ~1–3 Å; success rate within 2 Å typically in the ~30–70% range depending on dataset and flexibility
reputation: Valued within computational structural biology and drug-discovery circles for joint evaluation of protein and ligand modeling methods, though adoption is specialized to the field.
notes: Performance heavily dependent on receptor flexibility, dataset composition, and preprocessing; limited experimental-complex diversity and possible training/test contamination if methods were trained on overlapping complexes; evaluation sensitive to alignment and protonation/water handling.
